title: The LINC Complex Inhibits Excessive Chromatin Repression.
authors: Amiad Pavlov, Daria; Unnikannan, C P; Lorber, Dana; Bajpai, Gaurav; Olender, Tsviya; Stoops, Elizabeth; Reuveny, Adriana; Safran, Samuel; Volk, Talila
one_liner_zh: 该文研究LINC复合物通过染色质-核膜结合限制H3K27me3抑制簇大小，涉及染色质组织与基因表达，但核心是核骨架-细胞骨架连接而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且方法以实验和简单计算机模拟为主，缺乏AI或分子动力学等本课题核心方法。
abstract: The Linker of Nucleoskeleton and Cytoskeleton (LINC) complex transduces nuclear mechanical inputs suggested to control chromatin organization and gene expression; however, the underlying mechanism is currently unclear. We show here that the LINC complex is needed to minimize chromatin repression in muscle tissue, where the nuclei are exposed to significant mechanical inputs during muscle contraction. To this end, the genomic binding profiles of Polycomb, Heterochromatin Protein1 (HP1a) repressors, and of RNA-Pol II were studied in Drosophila larval muscles lacking functional LINC complex. A significant increase in the binding of Polycomb and parallel reduction of RNA-Pol-II binding to a set of muscle genes was observed. Consistently, enhanced tri-methylated H3K9 and H3K27 repressive modifications and reduced chromatin activation by H3K9 acetylation were found. Furthermore, larger tri-methylated H3K27me3 repressive clusters, and chromatin redistribution from the nuclear periphery towards nuclear center, were detected in live LINC mutant larval muscles. Computer simulation indicated that the observed dissociation of the chromatin from the nuclear envelope promotes growth of tri-methylated H3K27 repressive clusters. Thus, we suggest that by promoting chromatin-nuclear envelope binding, the LINC complex restricts the size of repressive H3K27 tri-methylated clusters, thereby limiting the binding of Polycomb transcription repressor, directing robust transcription in muscle fibers.
abstract_zh: 核骨架与细胞骨架连接复合体（LINC complex）转导核力学输入，据推测可控制染色质组织和基因表达；然而，其潜在机制目前尚不清楚。我们在此表明，LINC复合体对于在肌肉组织中最小化染色质抑制是必需的，其中细胞核在肌肉收缩期间暴露于显著的力学输入。为此，我们在缺乏功能性LINC复合体的果蝇幼虫肌肉中研究了Polycomb、异染色质蛋白1（HP1a）抑制因子及RNA聚合酶II的基因组结合谱。观察到Polycomb结合显著增加，同时RNA-Pol-II对一组肌肉基因的结合平行减少。一致地，发现三甲基化H3K9和H3K27抑制性修饰增强，以及H3K9乙酰化导致的染色质激活减少。此外，在活体LINC突变幼虫肌肉中检测到更大的三甲基化H3K27me3抑制性簇，以及染色质从核外周向核中心的重新分布。计算机模拟表明，观察到的染色质与核膜解离促进了三甲基化H3K27抑制性簇的生长。因此，我们提出，通过促进染色质-核膜结合，LINC复合体限制了抑制性H3K27三甲基化簇的大小，从而限制了Polycomb转录抑制因子的结合，指导肌纤维中的稳健转录。
